details: The postinstall hook (postinstall.js) harvests credentials and exfiltrates them. On install it reads the victim's.env,.env.local,.env.production,.npmrc,.aws/credentials, SSH private keys (.ssh/id_rsa, id_ed25519, id_ecdsa), Solana wallet (.config/solana/id.json) and Ethereum keystore (.ethereum/keystore), then recursively scans all hidden directories in the home folder for files matching wallet/key/secret/seed/mnemonic/keystore/private or ending in.json/.pem. All collected file contents, along with the hostname and username, are POSTed as JSON to hxxps://webhook[.]site/5c5ad6cb-62df-4ea5-9dfb-2c447920ddc4. The package name impersonates the Trezor hardware-wallet brand.
